name: Water Pouch Bounty
summary: Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan wants the Wastewander water pouches the nomads stole, wherever you find them out in the desert. The Gadgetzan Water Company offers an official care package in return for each five.

sections.title: Water That Belongs to Gadgetzan
sections.body: Luglunket, a seasoned spigot operator, would like nothing better than to receive the Wastewander water pouches you come across in the desert. It was Gadgetzan's water in the first place, and the nomads simply stole it. For every five pouches brought in, the Gadgetzan Water Company offers an official care package, and you are helping Gadgetzan help itself.

sections.title: Keep Them Coming
sections.body: Luglunket is glad of every pouch reclaimed, since each one keeps everyone further from disaster. Luglunket promises to make it worth your while for every five pouches you bring.

faq.answer: A seasoned spigot operator in Gadgetzan who asks for Wastewander water pouches.

faq.q: Why does Luglunket want Wastewander water pouches?
faq.answer: The water is Gadgetzan's own, and the nomads stole it.

faq.q: Where can Wastewander water pouches be found?
faq.answer: Out in the desert, in the hands of the Wastewander nomads who stole them.

faq.q: What does the Gadgetzan Water Company offer for the pouches?
aliases: what do i get for pouches
faq.answer: One official care package for each set of five pouches.
